annotations.title: Store an API key for a page

description: Secrets proxy (Pro): store a third-party API key server-side so a published page can call that API without exposing the key. name is UPPER_SNAKE, base_url is the only upstream it may reach; optional slug, header (default authorization), template (default 'Bearer {value}'). The page then calls fetch('/api/proxy?drop=<handle>/<slug>&secret=<NAME>&path=/v1/...'). Replaces a key with the same name.
name: set_secret
title: Store an API key for a page
